verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs show both admin-side session management ("manage users, including permissions and sessions" via admin console/REST API) and end-user self-service ("Users can also manage sessions as well as view history for the account" in the Account Console) alongside single-sign-out to log out of all apps at once. This covers per-user and bulk session revocation for both admins and end users, though the evidence doesn't explicitly show device fingerprinting/naming UI or independent hands-on confirmation of the revoke flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a device list view, independent/hands-on validation of individual vs bulk revoke actions.
